wiki.title: Natasha Johnson
wiki.extract: Natasha Johnson (born 1977/1978) is an American politician and businesswoman who has served in the California State Assembly from the 63rd district since September 2025, after winning a special election to replace Bill Essayli. She previously served on the city council of Lake Elsinore, California from 2012 to 2025, including three one-year terms as mayor.
